title: Vaile Mansion
scope: The surviving Harvey M. Vaile Mansion in Independence, including the east porch, center tower, slate mansard, side dormers and attached rear wing.
limitations: Vertical proportions are initial estimates from the surveyed plan and frontal photographs. The approximate tower projection and heights need checking against the reference scale before authoring.
Scope includes the standing mansion and attached rear wing. Any detached greenhouse or carriage house is excluded.
Some smaller ornament and rear openings are approximate.
